Station: Bori-police-station (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: HA-type
Aquifer depth: 7.44 – 45 m
Recommendation: Target the moderately resistive sandy layer between 7.44 m and 45 m depth as the primary aquifer zone; drill to at least 50 m to fully penetrate this layer and confirm whether the underlying high-resistivity unit (700 Ω·m) represents a productive fractured basement or a non-aquiferous bedrock.

Station: Court-road (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: KH-type
Aquifer depth: 62.9–114 m
Recommendation: Target the moderately resistive (51.6 ohm-m) layer between 62.9 m and 114 m depth as the main aquifer zone; drill through the overlying resistive layer (701 ohm-m, 12.9–62.9 m) with appropriate casing to prevent collapse, and confirm water strike with cuttings/geophysical logging as drilling approaches 60 m.

Station: Gokana-street (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: HA-type
Aquifer depth: 17.4 m – 50.9 m
Recommendation: Target the moderately resistive sandy layer (2246 Ω·m) between 17.4 m and 50.9 m as the main productive aquifer zone; screen the borehole within this interval and avoid terminating in the underlying very high-resistivity layer (>34,000 Ω·m), which likely represents a compact/indurated or non-productive formation.

Station: Kogam-street (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: H-A type
Aquifer depth: 6.45 m – 57.3 m
Recommendation: Target the sandy/sand-gravel sequence between ~6.5 m and 57 m (layers of 126–149 Ω·m) for well screening, avoiding the shallow low-resistivity clay layer (0.8–6.45 m) which should be sealed off with grout to prevent contamination; confirm lithology with drill cuttings as the high-resistivity basal layer (197 Ω·m) is reached, as it may represent either a deeper coarse aquifer or bedrock.

Station: Kor-road (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: KH-type
Aquifer depth: >111 m (within Layer 4, 581 ohm-m)
Recommendation: Drill to a minimum depth of 111 m to penetrate the resistive overburden/bedrock sequence and reach the lower-resistivity Layer 4, which is interpreted as the main water-bearing unit; ensure proper casing through the upper 111 m of higher-resistivity formations to prevent borehole collapse and cross-contamination.

Station: Market-road (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: AAK-type (ascending resistivity trend through layers 1–4, reversing at layer 5)
Aquifer depth: 5.24 m – 54.6 m (Layers 3 and 4, resistive sand/sandstone horizon)
Recommendation: Target drilling and screen placement within the 5.24–54.6 m interval where resistivities of 266–327 ohm-m indicate a saturated sandy aquifer; case off the upper clayey/lateritic zone (0–5.24 m) to prevent contamination, and confirm the base of the aquifer near 54.6 m before penetrating the lower-resistivity (219 ohm-m) layer, which may represent a clayey or weathered basement unit.

Station: Egwi
Curve type: A-type (ρ1<ρ2<ρ3<ρ4<ρ5, continuously ascending)
Aquifer depth: >37.25 m (top of highly resistive Layer 5, thickness not bottomed out by sounding)
Recommendation: Target the thick, highly resistive sand/gravel unit below 37.25 m depth for the production borehole; drill and case through the overlying clayey/sandy sequence (0–37.25 m) and confirm aquifer top with lithologic logging during drilling, as the VES did not resolve the base of this high-resistivity unit.

Station: Odufor

Station: Opiro
